name: CERBERUS FOSSAE — gap crossing

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 351 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Gap crossing. The fissure itself is narrower than a 200 m pixel, so the gap is authored; the DEM supplies the plain it cuts.

blurb: A fissure across the line of travel. WorldVLA arrives at speed and bounds late — 20.7 deg of pitch and 11.9 deg of roll as it commits — while PragyaSpace stops, preloads, spans deliberately and lands where it aimed, at 9.5 deg and 0.7 deg.

metrics.signature: normal walk → late detect → brake / half-step hesitation → emergency bound → overshoot → recovery
approach → stop → assess → preload → low-arc planned span → precise landing → rear-foot transfer
